findings.text: The suite asserts render-receipt.json's self-reported title_lines, legend_entries and glyph counts, which the same driver call also writes -- it does not parse pixels from single-null-contact-shadow.png. A driver bug that drew a mismatched glyph while recording the correct one in the receipt would pass this suite; this review closed that gap by opening the PNG directly and re-deriving the numeric title fields from the upstream receipt.json rows, which did match to the digit, but the suite alone does not provide that guarantee going forward.

justifications.durability: The render entry point (`python -m benchmarks.limiter_read_resolution_audit render`) reads only the committed receipt.json and enters no solve (RENDER_EXIT=0 in seconds per render-entry-point.log), so the regression check is cheap enough to run on every gate rather than being deferred to a manual H200 re-run -- unlike several sibling fsa reviews in this sprint. The test module carries no slow marker and is real, not a stub. Docked 3 points for the same reason noted under evidence: the assertions read the driver's own render-receipt.json rather than the rendered pixels, so the loop is closed by this review's manual image inspection, not by the suite alone -- a future driver regression that mis-records its own receipt would pass CI.
justifications.evidence: Independently reproduced rather than trusted: tests/test_limiter_read_render.py -p no:cacheprovider gives 7 passed in 4.95s (render-test-pass.log) against a real pytest run, not a template placeholder, and is wired into the default gate (no slow marker). The declared negative control was re-read line by line: negative-control.log states the mutation verbatim (wall_contact marker reset to the axis triangle, the wall_contact legend entry deleted, title truncated) and the pytest body shows exactly 3 failed / 4 passed, failing test_the_title_reports_the_fixture_cells_residual_and_convergence_flag, test_every_glyph_family_the_figure_draws_has_a_legend_entry and test_the_contact_glyph_is_distinct_from_the_axis_and_the_saddle -- the three guarded conditions and no others. I re-derived the title numbers from docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/limiter-read/receipt.json myself (not from the manifest's restatement): of the 4 rows sharing case=diverted-single-null, requested_cells=-1000, the wall_nodes=481 row carries level_error_in_span=9.852875804959903e-05 (-> 'residual=9.853e-05' in the title) and production_contact.position_error_m=0.0019081173944107967 (-> 'contact offset ... 1.908e-03 m'), and render.excluded_wall_nodes has length 18 (-> 'excluded_private_wall_glyphs': 18). All re-derive to the digit. -1 because the test suite asserts against render-receipt.json's self-reported title_lines/glyph counts rather than parsing the rendered PNG pixels directly, so a driver bug that drew one thing while recording another in the receipt would not be caught by the suite alone -- only by the image review performed here.
justifications.fit: The driver renders through the repo's own painters (nova.media.poloidal.draw_wall, nova.media.poloidal.draw_nulls) and nova.media.ink (DEFAULT_INK, poloidal_axes), matching the idiom of other forward-state figures rather than inventing a parallel drawing path. The figure obeys all four binding plotting rules verified by direct inspection: axis off with no gridlines, the analytic flux map drawn as unfilled line contours, both admitted stationary points marked with the standard vocabulary (solid triangle axis, filled cross saddle), and the wall drawn at its full 481-node resolution including the exempted private-wall nodes the panel previously omitted.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All three audited defects (score 30 in docs/evidence/archive/figure-and-solver-audit-landed.html #figures-cut-cell-20-limiter-read-single-null-contact-shadow-png-30) are repaired and independently verified by opening single-null-contact-shadow.png: (1) '-30 rules/honesty, no text of any kind' -- the panel now carries a 7-line title, a 6-entry legend and an axis-off poloidal frame; (2) '-20 physics, the draw_nulls magnetic-axis triangle placed at the contact point' -- the contact is now a distinct blue diamond ('wall_contact': 'D') separate from the red axis triangle ('magnetic_axis': '^') and the red admitted-saddle cross ('admitted_x_point': 'X'); (3) '-20 the purple marker cluster is unexplained' -- the legend now carries 'private-wall nodes exempted from the read' and the receipt records excluded_private_wall_glyphs=18. -1 only because the title spans 7 wrapped lines, more verbose than the repo's other forward-state captions, though every line is load-bearing provenance.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat db30ed9428f3bbfbb1f514d8c7302211b46027bc lists exactly the 8 files the manifest's changed_paths names, all inside the declared orientation_write_paths (benchmarks/limiter_read_resolution_audit.py, tests/test_limiter_read_render.py, docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/limiter-read/*, docs/plans/figure-and-solver-audit.html, docs/evidence/archive/figure-and-solver-audit-landed.html). No sibling limiter-read figure or unrelated receipt was touched. One commit, conventional subject plus a body, no plan/sprint/ticket identifiers, no AI attribution.
